member.name: M:Nalix.Hosting.Protocols.DefaultFrameProcessor.ProcessFrame(System.Object,Nalix.Abstractions.Networking.IConnectionEventArgs)
member.summary: Processes an incoming network frame from a connected client. Applies inbound pipeline transformations (e.g., decrypt, decompress), optionally replaces the underlying buffer lease, then forwards the processed message to the protocol layer for handling.
member.param: The source of the event triggering this frame processing.
Connection event arguments containing the frame data and connection context.
member.remarks:
This method is performance-critical and is intentionally marked with to avoid stepping into during debugging sessions.
Pipeline behavior:
Validates and extracts the buffer lease from event args.
Applies inbound transformations via FramePipeline.ProcessInbound.
Replaces the lease if pipeline produces a new buffer.
Forwards the event to protocol handler.
member.exception: Thrown when lease is missing from event args.
Unhandled exceptions are logged and reported to connection error handler.
